body:
## Pull request overview

This PR advances ObjectUI’s v2.0.7 alignment by adding schema-level accessibility (ARIA propagation), responsive utilities/layout primitives, and deeper i18n spec formatter support, along with supporting tests/benchmarks and roadmap/dependency updates.

**Changes:**
- Add AriaPropsSchema extraction in `SchemaRenderer` and corresponding tests.
- Introduce responsive breakpoint utilities: `ResponsiveGrid` (layout) and `useResponsiveConfig` (mobile).
- Add spec-aligned i18n formatters, lazy language loading in `I18nProvider`, WCAG contrast utilities in `ThemeEngine`, plus a11y tests and benches.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 19 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated 11 comments.

`COLS_CLASSES` only enumerates a subset of column counts (1/2/3/4/6/12), but the docstring says 1–12. Tailwind supports `grid-cols-1` through `grid-cols-12`, so values like 5, 7, 8, etc. will be mapped to the wrong layout. Prefer explicit 1–12 mappings per breakpoint or validate/reject unsupported values instead of guessing.

`BreakpointOrderMap` is declared here but not used anywhere. If ordering isn’t supported by `ResponsiveGrid` yet, removing this interface will avoid implying functionality that doesn’t exist; otherwise, wire it into the component’s API and implementation.
```suggestion

```
ROADMAP test/build totals here (e.g. “3011 tests pass”) don’t match the PR description (3020 tests, 155 files). Please reconcile these numbers so the roadmap reflects the actual CI totals.

`SpecResponsiveConfig.breakpoint` is defined but never used in the hook. If the spec schema includes a “target breakpoint” concept, it should affect resolution; otherwise, removing the field will prevent consumers from thinking it does something.

`componentProps` still includes AriaPropsSchema keys like `ariaLabel` / `ariaDescribedBy`, so spreading `...componentProps` will forward them as non-standard DOM attributes (e.g. `arialabel`, `ariadescribedby`) in addition to the normalized `aria-*` attributes. Please omit these keys from `componentProps` before spreading so only valid HTML attributes are passed through.

`gap` handling has two issues: (1) when `gap` is a string, `gapClass` becomes `''` so the caller can’t pass a Tailwind class like `'gap-6'`; (2) the numeric fallback builds `gap-${gap}` dynamically, which Tailwind JIT typically won’t include unless safelisted. Prefer accepting a string Tailwind class verbatim, and for numbers keep a fully-enumerated static map of supported `gap-*` classes (or document/validate the allowed values).
```suggestion
  const gapClass =
    typeof gap === 'string'
      ? gap
      : GAP_CLASSES[gap] ?? GAP_CLASSES[4];
```

`ResponsiveGrid` is registered for schema-driven rendering, but it requires React `children`. When invoked via `SchemaRenderer`, `children` will not be passed (SchemaRenderer strips schema `children` from props), so this will render an empty grid. Consider switching this renderer to consume `{ schema }` and render `schema.children`/`schema.body` (e.g., via the shared `renderChildren()` helper).

The comment says `evaluatedSchema.props` overrides schema fields, but `ariaProps` are spread after `evaluatedSchema.props`, so `schema.ariaLabel` will override an explicitly provided `props['aria-label']`. Either update the comment, or change spread order / conditional injection so explicit props remain the final override.
```suggestion
    ...ariaProps,  // Inject ARIA attributes from AriaPropsSchema
    ...(evaluatedSchema.props || {}),  // Override with explicit props if provided
```

`ComponentRegistry` (core `Registry`) doesn’t expose an `unregister` API, so `ComponentRegistry.unregister?.('test-widget')` is a no-op and the registration leaks across the test run. Use a unique, namespaced type with `skipFallback: true` to minimize global pollution, or add/ use a real unregister/clear mechanism in tests.

These assertions verify `aria-*` injection, but they won’t catch accidental forwarding of `ariaLabel`/`ariaDescribedBy` as invalid DOM attributes (e.g. `arialabel`). Consider adding explicit negative assertions for those camelCase props to prevent regressions.
